fixed_similarity_rule.quantity: Pearson correlation of independently min-max normalized close vectors

target_window: Last N consecutive genuine native grid intervals at Y, inclusive of the latest interval with source end < S and availability <= S. Missing intervals remain in the window and invalidate it; never choose an older complete window instead.
normalization: For each vector separately, z_i=(close_i-min(close))/(max(close)-min(close)), oldest to newest. All N closes finite and positive; constant range or any unknown gives unknown. Doji included by close; colour/body/wick/pivot rules do not enter the calculation. All tied extrema map to the same0/1; no unique anchor bar is chosen.
arithmetic: Binary64 reference in world_chart_shape.py, math.fsum means and centered products; clamp only final rho outside[-1,1]. Strict >0.90, no epsilon, tolerance, rounding, time warping, resampling/interpolation or offset optimization.
candidate_pool: Every distinct (ticker,Y,candle_start,candle_end) window of the authenticated approved universe and entire available source history, ending < S with availability <= S and explicit historical eligibility at its availability. No shortlist, similarity preselection or hidden history cap. Exclude the identical target window only; other overlapping windows remain and must be disclosed. Unknown source/eligibility cannot be treated as ineligible or silently removed from a full-pool claim.
candidate_pit: Target eligibility is as of S; candidate eligibility is as of its native availability. Apply standing tradeable/>=$100M policy with raw nominal prices and shares known then; do not infer it from adjusted shape prices or current classifications. Universe/source membership is versioned; survivor scope remains explicit.
outcome: R_K=close(candidate_end + K actual market sessions)/close(candidate_end)-1. K is daily trading sessions for every Y, including monthly. Both exact endpoint prices finite and positive and endpoint date < S. No setup-day input, no future close, no jumping a missing price, no extrapolation.
ranking: All strict matches sorted by rho descending, candidate end descending, ticker UTF-8 ascending, candidate start ascending. Top5 from this complete order, independent of K. Exact identities unique; all other overlaps kept and labelled. No approximate search may exclude an unverified candidate.

items.item: Historical close-shape matches and known K-session outcomes

outputs.name: match_count
outputs.definition: Count all strict >0.90 matches after a complete eligible-pool scan. Known zero only when the valid complete scan found none.
outputs.viewport_draw: Recolour exactly the N target native candles purple; show count, full pool scope and exact window dates.

outputs.name: matured_count
outputs.definition: Count matching windows whose exact K-session outcome endpoint and prices are known before S.
outputs.viewport_draw: Label the known-return denominator and K on the shape pane; display outcome endpoint dates for shown matches.

outputs.name: up_pct
outputs.definition: 100*count(R_K>0)/matured_count. Zero return is not up. Unknown when matured_count=0.
outputs.viewport_draw: Show up numerator/known denominator and percentage; mark each displayed match's K-endpoint on its historical mini-chart only when known.

outputs.name: median_return
outputs.definition: Exact median of known R_K, midpoint of the two central observations when even. Unknown when matured_count=0; no approximate quantile.
outputs.viewport_draw: Show the median as a labelled historical statistic beside the matched mini-charts and K endpoints.

outputs.name: top5_geometry
outputs.definition: First up to5 matches in the exact ranking, whether or not a particular K outcome has matured. Geometry/receipt, not an extra scored scalar question.
outputs.viewport_draw: Current normalized close line purple plus top5 matched lines aligned at relative candle positions0..N-1; label literal tickers, start/end, rho and overlap. Current N candles remain purple. Unknown K outcomes have no return label.

items.item: Identical-window normalized close comparison to literal benchmark or PIT peer

outputs.name: shape_correlation
outputs.definition: Same normalized-close correlation on exactly identical N candle interval keys. Role chosen with membership known before S; one literal comparator for the entire window, no splicing, averaging or current-map backfill. Self-comparison excluded.
outputs.viewport_draw: Recolour target N candles purple; overlay target and comparator's own-window0..1 close lines on the same absolute candle dates. Label ticker/ETF/peer identities, membership-as-of date, N/Y, rho and cutoff S.

aliases_and_counts: match_count/top5 do not depend on K. I228 has no K axis. Normalized-close Pearson and raw-close Pearson are mathematically one positive-affine-invariant formula, not separate questions. Counts of grid records are not unique question counts. Full v3 facets/registered thresholds/history and empirical quality are still required.
unavailable: Target window unknown => all shape answers unknown, not zero. Unauthenticated/incomplete pool or unknown required eligibility => no full-universe answer. With complete known pool, no matches => match_count=0 and matured_count=0; up_pct/median blank. Missing peer membership or mismatched intervals => I228 unknown. No current-map or SPY fallback for sector/theme roles.
scope: Raw inventory/history definitions and reference arithmetic only. No full search implementation, complete universe measurement, renderer validation, v3/P3b, PIT eligibility, storage-cap or scoring acceptance. Historical up percentages are descriptive matched-window features, not net-profit probabilities or independent observations. Kimi owns rendering.
